data.description: You can excavate and move an amount of snow, earth, dust, sand, and loose or packed rocks or ice chunks (each no more than 5 feet in diameter) whose volume fills %1 five-foot cubes. If you are buried, you can open a space around yourself and use any remaining cubes for tunneling. This spell is otherwise similar to expeditious excavation. Carve passage has no effect on earth creatures or solid rock or ice.
